title: Localization issue in French in the save and restore settings section
author: Fuzzy2319
summary: The French General > Back up and restore view labels a backup creation date as if it were a physical address. The report identifies the intended date wording and the exact source resource key behind the UI label.

judgment.rationale: The report supplies the affected language, visible incorrect phrase, intended alternatives, and a screenshot. Public source inspection identifies the exact General backup date resource key and confirms that the English source text is date-related, so a narrow localization correction is justified without requesting more reporter evidence.
evidence: Issue #50751 is open and labeled Issue-Bug, Area-Localization, Needs-Triage, and Issue-Translation.
The reporter identifies French as the affected language and reports the visible phrase “Créé à l’adresse suivante :”.
The reporter explains that “adresse” denotes a location and proposes “Créé à la date suivante :” or “Créé le :” instead.
The issue includes a screenshot of the affected Save and restore settings UI and has no comments, assignee, linked work, or duplicate signal.

The public English resource at https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/main/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/Strings/en-us/Resources.resw defines General_SettingsBackupInfo_DateHeader.Text as “Created at:”, confirming the label represents a backup creation date.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve a focused localization correction for the French value of General_SettingsBackupInfo_DateHeader.Text, using the repository localization workflow and verifying the rendered General backup date label.

confidence.rationale: The affected UI text is directly shown in the report, and the corresponding public source key is unambiguously a backup date header. Only the localization-pipeline write location, not the correction itself, remains to be routed.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt or linked pull request covers this translation. A focused localization update is applicable; the French catalog is not stored beside the public en-us resource in the inspected checkout, so the maintainer must use the established localization workflow rather than edit unrelated English source text.

proposed_fixes.title: Correct the French backup creation-date label
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The French localization for General_SettingsBackupInfo_DateHeader.Text uses “adresse”, which means a physical address, instead of date terminology for the backup creation timestamp.
plan: Locate the French localization entry corresponding to General_SettingsBackupInfo_DateHeader.Text in the established PowerToys localization workflow.
Replace the incorrect phrase with a natural date label such as “Créé le :” or the approved equivalent used by the French localization guidelines.
Build or package the Settings UI with the updated French resources and verify the General > Back up and restore date header renders as a date label.
verification: Open PowerToys Settings in French and navigate to General > Back up and restore.
Create or select a settings backup so the date header is visible.
Confirm the label uses date wording and no longer contains “adresse”.
Check that the resource key remains General_SettingsBackupInfo_DateHeader.Text and that other languages are unchanged.

confidence.rationale: The issue screenshot and wording identify the defect directly, while the public source key confirms the affected text is specifically a backup creation-date header.

issue_context.summary: A French translation in General > Back up and restore uses “adresse” for a backup creation date. The reporter supplies a screenshot and two date-oriented corrections.

The visible phrase is “Créé à l’adresse suivante :”.
The reporter proposes “Créé à la date suivante :” or “Créé le :”.
The issue includes a screenshot and no discussion comments or linked work.
The public English Settings resource key General_SettingsBackupInfo_DateHeader.Text has the value “Created at:”.
The issue is labeled as both a bug and a translation/localization issue.
inferences: The French value is likely a mistranslation of the date header rather than a problem with backup metadata or date formatting.
The correction should be made through the localization pipeline because the public checkout exposes the en-us source resource but not a French resource file beside it.
issue_context.analysis: The report contains enough evidence to distinguish a translation defect from a functional backup problem. The exact source key and English value identify the narrow change boundary; no logs, repro diagnostics, or additional reporter clarification would materially improve the fix decision.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body, labels, metadata, timeline, and discussion; the issue has no comments, assignee, linked PR, duplicate, or maintainer request.
Inspected the public Settings UI resource at src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/Strings/en-us/Resources.resw.
Confirmed General_SettingsBackupInfo_DateHeader.Text is the source label and its English value is “Created at:”.
Confirmed the related General backup UI uses this resource key for the backup information date header.
Checked repository history for the source resource; no issue-specific fix or linked work was found.

design.root_cause: The French localization value for General_SettingsBackupInfo_DateHeader.Text mistranslates the backup creation-date label with the location word “adresse”.
evidence: Issue #50751 screenshot and body show the incorrect French phrase and explain its location-related meaning.
The public source resource defines General_SettingsBackupInfo_DateHeader.Text as “Created at:”.
GeneralPage.xaml binds the backup information UI through the General_SettingsBackupAndRestoreStatusInfo resource scope, and the date header key is part of the same Settings resource set.

affected_files.purpose: Public source resource that establishes the affected resource key and date-label semantics; it should not be changed for this issue.
General Settings view that renders the backup information resource scope.
Localization-workflow entry to update; the French catalog location is not present beside the public en-us source in the inspected checkout.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: The French UI displays “Créé à l’adresse suivante :” for the backup creation date.
implementation_steps.change: Replace the French value with the approved natural date wording, preferably “Créé le :” unless localization maintainers select an equivalent consistent with existing terminology.

edge_cases: Do not change the English source resource or alter date formatting placeholders elsewhere.
Use the repository's localization approval and synchronization path so the correction is not overwritten by generated resource updates.
Verify the chosen French wording remains grammatical when followed by the rendered localized date.
tests: Open the General backup UI in French and verify the corrected date header renders.
Confirm the resource key and all non-French translations remain unchanged.

verify: Use the established localization workflow to build or sync the French resource.
Launch PowerToys Settings in French, open General > Back up and restore, and make a backup if needed to display the backup information.
Confirm the date header reads with date terminology, such as “Créé le :”, and no longer uses “adresse”.
risks: The French catalog may be maintained outside the public source checkout, so editing the English resource would not fix the reported UI and could create an unrelated translation change.
The selected French wording should follow the localization team's terminology conventions rather than assuming the reporter's first alternative is mandatory.
alternatives: Use “Créé à la date suivante :” if the French localization guidelines favor a fuller phrase; this is a wording choice within the same resource key.
Request more reporter evidence was rejected because the screenshot, exact phrase, expected meaning, and source key already establish the defect.
